Package org.geysermc.paletter.internal

Class CanonicalItems

java.lang.Object
org.geysermc.paletter.internal.CanonicalItems
public final class CanonicalItems extends Object
Dense, version independent item variant indices ("canonical" ids), the item counterpart of CanonicalBlocks. The newest bundled version defines them, stable for a Paletter release:
  1. the base variant (identifier, damage 0, no block state) of every item, in runtime id order;
  2. every other variant of its creative inventory (damage values, block states), in creative order.
Custom items and custom block items of layers are appended per lineage of layers, like custom block states.

A variant is an identifier and an aux value; the block state of a stack is not part of it, so creative stacks that differ only by block state are one variant. [@link #index(ItemVariant)] ignores the block state of a variant.

Since:
1.0.0

      public @NonNull CanonicalItems extend(@NonNull Object key, @NonNull List<ItemVariant> additional)
      Parameters:
      key - identifies the extension (e.g. the layer adding the items); the same key returns the same instance for as long as it is referenced
      additional - variants to append, e.g. base variants of custom items. Variants that already have an id (here or earlier in the list) are skipped; a block state equal to the item's default is dropped
      Returns:
      these indices with the given variants appended, or this if there are none

      public @NonNull Forwarding forward(@NonNull ItemVariant variant)
      Maps a variant of any bundled version to the canonical ids, which the newest version defines. Items Bedrock renamed or split are looked up under their new identifier and aux. A variant the newest version does not have (the item is gone, or has no such aux value) is Forwarding.Kind.UNKNOWN with the reason.
